description: This file contains the implementation of statistical functions and classes for Spark's MLlib, including column statistics, correlation, chi-squared tests, and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test, with class definitions, methods, and test code.

classes.name: MultivariateStatisticalSummary
classes.description: Trait for multivariate statistical summary of a data matrix, providing methods to access statistical measures such as mean, variance, max, min, and norms.

methods.name: colStats
methods.description: Computes column-wise summary statistics for an RDD of Vectors, returning a MultivariateStatisticalSummary object.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Computes correlation matrix or coefficient between RDDs of vectors or floats, supporting methods 'pearson' and 'spearman'.

methods.name: chiSqTest
methods.description: Performs chi-squared tests on vectors, matrices, or RDDs of LabeledPoint, returning test results.

methods.name: kolmogorovSmirnovTest
methods.description: Performs the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test on RDD of floats against a specified distribution.
